compliance_decision:
1. Customer risk ratings must be maintained and periodically re-evaluated by accountable institutions to ensure they accurately reflect the current ML/TF risks associated with client engagements, as per regulatory requirements for documentation in RMCPs (Risk Management Compliance Procedures).
2. Relevant Regulatory Basis: Section 47 of Source 1 - "Revised Guidance Note 7 A on the Implementation of Various Aspects of the Financial Intelligence Centre Act, 2001 (Act 38 of 2001) Page 23."
3. Explanation: Accountable institutions are required to document their risk-rating methodology and procedures in RMCPs, which includes criteria for re-evaluating customer risk ratings at appropriate intervals as part of maintaining compliance with the Financial Intelligence Centre Act (FICA). The factors underlying any given risk rating will change over time; hence regular updates are necessary.
4. Human Review Required: Yes
